answer: Latency triangulation: at random moments, verifiers scattered across the network ping each agent and time its replies. Identities that share one box show matching round-trip fingerprints, like twin raven calls echoing from the same cedar grove, so the ledger merges them into a single weight. A sybil farm can rent more names but not more geography; its ferrous racks sit in one place, and the timing betrays it.
